snapshot.title: Clarify debrief Resolve action with plain language
snapshot.description: The debrief CTA says Resolve which is internal game language. First-time players hesitate unsure whether it is destructive, optional, or time-limited.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Resolve button is relabelled to something self-explanatory (e.g. Collect Payout or Complete Mission)
Debrief screen shows a one-line summary of what the player will receive before they click
